meta.name: Sonic The Hedgehog [1080p] [BluRay] [5 1] [YTS MX]
meta.description: Powered with incredible speed, Sonic The Hedgehog embraces his new home on Earth. That is, until Sonic sparks the attention of super-uncool evil genius Dr. Robotnik. Now it’s super-villain vs. super-sonic in an all-out race across the globe to stop Robotnik from using Sonic’s unique power for world domination.
meta.slogan: A whole new speed of hero.
